reason: At ₹99 for 100 grams, this is priced at an outrageous premium compared to mainstream sauces that cost one-third as much. I also don't trust squeeze tubes in the fridge because they inevitably separate and squirt out runny water onto your food.
objection: Unjustified premium price per gram and the persistent issue of watery liquid separating at the nozzle.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of emulsion stability and a bundle price bringing the cost down below ₹65 per 100g on Zepto.
